structured_output.what_is_happening: DAH (Dinosaurs And Humans) is a 16-minute-old token. Its pool was created directly on PumpSwap (migrated_unix=0, no launchpad, never on a bonding curve). Liquidity ($41k) is larger than the market cap ($28k), which means the deployer seeded the pool with a lot of SOL, and 100% of the LP is unlocked. In one burst it traded $247k (6x turnover) with 1,117 unique buyers against only 116 sellers. GMGN tags 1,000 of 1,114 holders as fresh wallets and 33 as bundlers. It has no socials, no website and no description. Price is up about 50-69% since launch and sits near its all-time high.

narrative.why_spreading: Nothing suggests organic spread. The activity looks like a flood of fresh wallets buying, not community discovery.

token_connection.competing_tokens: GYS1v9...pump 'Dream And Hold' DAH: dead, not a real competitor.

authenticity.evidence: 1,000 of 1,114 holders are fresh wallets. Unique buyers outnumber sellers about 10:1 (1,117 vs 116) in the first 15 minutes. There are 33 bundler wallets, and the top bundler trader holds 12.3%. The top10 share is flat and low (6%), which fits spraying many wallets to fake breadth. There are no socials at all, but the token hit 1,100+ holders in 15 minutes anyway.
authenticity.uncertainty: Fresh wallets can also be real new retail users or trading-bot users. GMGN's fresh tagging is imprecise.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked on a PumpSwap pool the deployer created directly, so the deployer can remove the liquidity at any time
Liquidity is larger than the market cap, meaning the deployer seeded the SOL, the classic setup for pulling the LP
Holder base is mostly fresh wallets, which looks manufactured

structured_output.counterargument: Mint and freeze authority are renounced, holders are widely spread, top10 is only about 6%, and there are no snipers. Deep liquidity relative to the market cap means a 2x only needs about $28k of extra market cap. If the fresh-wallet flow is real retail coming from a trending feed, the momentum (m5 pace 3.7x the hourly pace, near ATH) could carry it to $60k+ within hours. The creator's previous token reached a $179k ATH.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a direct-PumpSwap LP-pull setup: a deployer-seeded pool, 100% unlocked LP, and a fresh-wallet buy flood to fake breadth, with no narrative or socials. The chance of a clean 2x before the liquidity is removed or price falls 50% is below the pool average.
